name: quarto-live-poll
description: Live polls and word clouds for Quarto revealjs decks, with a Cloudflare or Docker backend
author: Sean Davis

scripts.build: bun run build:deck && bun run build:audience && bun run build:node
scripts.build:deck: bun build src/deck/plugin.ts --target=browser --format=iife --banner '/*! live-poll | MIT | https://github.com/seandavi/quarto-live-poll | includes qrcode-generator, (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase, MIT: see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md */' --outfile=_extensions/live-poll/live-poll.js
